abstract: PlanMine is a web-based resource designed to facilitate bioinformatics analyses of genome, transcriptome, and gene expression datasets from planarians, free-living flatworms most well known for their large population of adult stem cells and extraordinary regenerative capabilities. This update incorporates high-quality genome sequences and annotations for multiple species in the widely studied Schmidtea genus, including both sexual and asexual strains of the model planarian Schmidtea mediterranea, while also expanding coverage of transcriptomes across the phylum Platyhelminthes (flatworms) to 70 species. New expression studies and tools are added to aid in the visualization and analysis of both bulk and single-cell RNA-seq data. Together, these resources will further empower complementary mechanistic studies in S. mediterranea and comparative approaches exploring the evolution of regeneration, parasitism, and other traits for which this increasingly tractable phylum represents an ideal model system. The PlanMine 4.0 database is freely accessible at https://planmine-v4.mpinat.mpg.de.
